_schema: Each claim has a status and checks. A check names a ledger entry id and the law, mechanism, metric and value it must have (or an exact field for measurement entries). tests/test_foundation.py verifies every check against results/evidence_ledger.jsonl. 'unverified' claims carry no checks and must not be used as findings.

claims.statement: On needs_expansion, M1 and M2 never recover the law (0/30 runs).
claims.caveat: Expected by construction: tanh is not in the base space H0 (control test in tests/test_core.py).

claims.statement: On needs_expansion, M3 expands the library in 30/30 runs and selects the exact true terms in 30/30 runs.
claims.caveat: The expansion library EXPANSION_LIB was written to contain the true operator. This shows the mechanism works when the operator is pre-specified. It does not show open-ended discovery.

claims.statement: On in_space, the recovered-count difference between M2 and M1 is 2 of 30 runs (below the pre-registered MCID of 0.2, i.e. 6 runs).
claims.caveat: Single 30-seed comparison. Not a power calculation. Says only that the observed difference is below the pre-registered MCID.

claims.statement: On the null law, false terms are selected in at most 5% of runs for each mechanism.
claims.caveat: Counts are out of 30 runs per mechanism (57-63%). BIC selection over subsets does not control false discoveries at n=30.

claims.statement: The exp01 runs.csv is reproduced byte-for-byte by the current code, and the ledger's measurement entries cite that file's SHA-256.
claims.caveat: Verified by tests/test_foundation.py::test_reproduces_committed_exp01 and by hashing the file on disk.

claims.statement: LLM agents can (or cannot) discover laws better than the algorithmic mechanisms at equal budget.
claims.caveat: No LLM was queried. Requires API approval. Not a finding.

claims.statement: External benchmarks report that most AI-agent research outputs fail provenance checks (figures from the strategy document).
claims.caveat: Primary sources not opened (see docs/ROADMAP.md, section 'to verify'). Must not be cited as fact.
